about.en: OORT is the token of OORT (Oortech), a decentralized cloud for AI that offers data collection and labelling, storage and compute through a network of independent nodes. OORT is the native coin of the project's Olympus Layer 1 and is also issued by the project as the token 0x5651fa7a726b9ec0cad00ee140179912b6e73599 on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
